title: Voxel Frontier
shortDescription: Explore a procedural 3D voxel wilderness, mine ores, craft tools, and build shelters.
description: Voxel Frontier is a single-player 3D voxel sandbox adventure across four distinct biomes: Emerald Plains, Timberland Forest, Cragspire Mountains, and Sunbaked Desert. Mine blocks, smelt ores, craft progressive tools, construct illuminated shelters, and save your worlds locally.
controls: WASD / Arrow Keys to move, Space to jump (double-tap in Creative to fly), Left Shift to sprint.
Mouse to look (Pointer Lock), Left-Click to mine or attack, Right-Click to place blocks, 1-9 / Scroll to select hotbar, E for inventory, C for crafting, Esc to pause.
saveNote: Worlds, block modifications, inventory, time of day, and settings are saved locally in IndexedDB and localStorage (pg:voxel-frontier:).
coverAlt: Voxel Frontier 3D procedural landscape with green grasslands, oak and pine trees, mountains, and voxel blocks.
